auth_note: Anonymous probe is refused with 401; docs say to create an account and press Generate a new key to get a token sent as a Bearer header.
rate_limit: Each endpoint individually rate-limited; example header shows X-RateLimit-Limit: 5000 daily queries per user, reset at midnight UTC
probe_observation: Probe returned HTTP 401 with JSON body {"message": "Missing \"Authorization\" in headers."}.

evidence.quote: Create an account and log in to the latest version of the [ADS](https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu). 1. Push the "Generate a new key" button
Each endpoint is individually rate-limited. ... The Limit variable indicates the amount of daily queries allowed to the user (in this case 5000).
You won’t try to create a partial or full copy of the data maintained and made available by the API, either by systematically downloading or crawling our content.

not_established: Docs page https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/help/api/ returned 202 with empty text (challenge); evidence comes from the GitHub README and terms page. Cost is not stated explicitly (key is self-serve). The actual default quota is only an example header value (5000/day), not a stated policy. Data license not stated: terms say publisher copyright applies to abstracts/full text and no redistribution. No bulk route; terms forbid systematic copying and say to contact ADS first.
